# Tiny Steps: Toddler Routines

> Tiny Steps: Toddler Routines is an iPhone app of picture routines that children aged 2–6 follow on their own, read aloud by a child-voice buddy. Made by Hau Ha Cong. Free to start, with an optional Premium (yearly or one-time lifetime).

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tiny-steps-toddler-routines/id6835329488
- Platform: iPhone, iOS 17 or later. Not on Android.
- Age rating: 4+. For parents and caregivers of children aged 2–6.
- Not to be confused with "Tiny Steps: Daily Routines", a different app.

## What it does
- Shows a routine (morning, bedtime, potty, leaving the house, after daycare) one big picture at a time, so children who cannot read can follow it.
- A girl or boy buddy reads each step aloud in a child's voice, cheers when a step is done, and celebrates at the end.
- Gentle countdown timer per step; a star for every step; stars are never taken away.
- Parents can build their own routines from 68 voiced step ideas, choose pictures, or take a photo of their own child doing the step.
- Weekday/weekend schedules with reminders; grown-up areas behind a grown-up check.

## Free vs Premium
- Free: one child, one routine, all pictures, voices, timers and stars.
- Premium: more children, unlimited routines, family sharing over iCloud (partners, grandparents, sitters), own voice recordings, buddy voice for custom step names.

## Privacy
- No account, no ads, no tracking. Data stays on the iPhone and in the family's own iCloud.
